The program of study for Preliminary SB 2042 Multiple Subje ct Credential includes authorization for teaching English Language learners. Admission to the program is required before core classes can be taken (exception: CPP juniors and seniors may enroll in EDU 5010 , EDU 5020 , EDU 5100 , and EDU 5302 ). Candidates wishing to concurrently earn the Bilingual Authorization must consult the coordinator of the Bilingual Program for admission to the program and develop a program plan. Information on the Multiple Subject program can be found at: https://www.cpp.edu/ceis/credential-program/preliminary-multiple-subject-credential.shtml. Information on the Bilingual Authorization can be found at https://www.cpp.edu/ceis/credential-program/bilingual-authorizations.shtml. Multiple Subject Credential coursework includes: Credential Required: 42 units EDU 5010 - Foundations of Teaching and Learning (3) EDU 5020 - Foundations of Education in a Diverse Society (3) EDU 5100 - Introduction to Literacy Instruction (3) EDU 5105 - Language Arts, Second Language Acquisition, and Children’s Literature (3) EDU 5110 - Theory and Practice in Mathematics Education (3) EDU 5115 - Theory and Practice in Science and Health Education (3) EDU 5120 - Theory and Practice in Teaching Elementary Social Sciences (3) EDU 5125 - Theory and Practice in Elementary Movement, Visual, Performing Arts Education (3) EDU 5150 - Novice Teaching for

courses.title: Foundations of Teaching and Learning
courses.description: Examines foundational learning, human development, and motivation theories and their applications, classroom management, and assessment. Opportunities for applied professional decision-making, planning, and reflection related to teaching and learning in a variety of contexts including TK-12. Includes 10 hours of field experience.
courses.prerequisites: ECS ITEP subplan/option, LS ITEP subplan/option, junior standing, senior standing, or admitted into Multiple Subject, Single Subject, or Education Specialist Credential.
courses.repeat_for_credit: May be taken multiple times Minimum - Maximum Units: Total credit limited to 6 units, with a maximum of 3 units per semester.

courses.title: Foundations of Education in a Diverse Society
courses.description: Examines foundations of schooling in the US with a focus on theoretical and historical approaches toward educational equity for diverse communities. Supports teacher candidates in developing culturally responsive teacher dispositions. Introduces sociolinguistic principles of effective pedagogies for English learners. May include up to 10 hours of field experience.
courses.prerequisites: ECS ITEP subplan/option, LS ITEP subplan/option, junior standing, senior standing, or admitted into Multiple Subject, Single Subject, or Education Specialist Credential.
courses.repeat_for_credit: May be taken multiple times Minimum - Maximum Units: Total credit limited to 6 units, with a maximum of 3 units per semester.

courses.title: Introduction to Literacy Instruction
courses.description: Theoretical models and pedagogical applications of literacy acquisition for native English speakers and English language learners. Emergent literacy, structure of language, phonemic awareness, phonics, fluency, vocabulary, comprehension, spelling and literacy assessment. 20 hours field experience.
courses.prerequisites: Junior or senior standing, or admitted into Multiple Subject, Single Subject, or Education Specialist Credential.
courses.repeat_for_credit: May be taken multiple times Minimum - Maximum Units: Total credit limited to 6 units, with a maximum of 3 units per semester.

courses.title: Language Arts, Second Language Acquisition, and Children’s Literature
courses.description: Theoretical models and pedagogical applications of language arts, writing and second language acquisition for native English speakers and English language learners. Investigation of genres, authors, illustrators and diversity in children’s literature.
courses.prerequisites: Admitted to Multiple Subject or Education Specialist Credential; EDU 5010 or TED 406; EDU 5020 , or TED 405 and TED 407; and EDU 5100 or TED 443.
courses.repeat_for_credit: May be taken multiple times Minimum - Maximum Units: Total credit limited to 6 units, with a maximum of 3 units per semester.

courses.title: Theory and Practice in Mathematics Education
courses.description: Principles and methodology of teaching mathematics in the elementary school including instructional design, material selection, and student assessment with an emphasis on problem solving. Fieldwork: May include a maximum 10 hours of field experience.
courses.prerequisites: Admitted to Multiple Subject Credential; EDU 5010 or TED 406; EDU 5020 , or TED 405 and TED 407; and EDU 5100 and TED 443.
courses.repeat_for_credit: May be taken multiple times Minimum - Maximum Units: Total credit limited to 6 units, with a maximum of 3 units per semester.

courses.title: Theory and Practice in Science and Health Education
courses.description: Principles and methodology of teaching science and health in the TK-8 classroom including pedagogical strategies, curriculum, instruction, and assessment. The teacher candidates will develop lesson plans based on state-adopted academic content standards that include all students in learning science and health. May include a maximum 10 hours of field experience.
courses.prerequisites: Admitted to Multiple Subject Credential; EDU 5010 or TED 406; EDU 5020 , or TED 405 and TED 407; and EDU 5100 or TED 443.
courses.repeat_for_credit: May be taken multiple times Minimum - Maximum Units: Total credit limited to 6 units, with a maximum of 3 units per semester.

courses.title: Theory and Practice in Teaching Elementary Social Sciences
courses.description: Examines principles and methodology of teaching, learning, and assessment of History and other Social Sciences in diverse elementary schools. Integrates multicultural and social justice education foundations into curriculum planning. Examines culturally relevant teaching principles for building reciprocal relations with diverse families and communities. May include a maximum of 10 hours of field experience.
courses.prerequisites: Admitted to Multiple Subject Credential; EDU 5010 or TED 406; EDU 5020 , or TED 405 and TED 407; and EDU 5100 .
courses.repeat_for_credit: May be taken multiple times Minimum - Maximum Units: Total credit limited to 6 units, with a maximum of 3 units per semester.

courses.title: Theory and Practice in Elementary Movement, Visual, Performing Arts Education
courses.description: Examines principles of culturally responsive teaching of physical education, visual arts, music, and other performing arts in diverse elementary classrooms. Analyzes ways of integrating the arts and movement into core curricula. Provides introduction to art history at the elementary level. May include field experience.
courses.repeat_for_credit: May be taken multiple times Minimum - Maximum Units: Total credit limited to 6 units, with a maximum of 3 units per semester.

courses.title: Novice Teaching for Elementary Teachers
courses.description: Limited supervised teaching in university approved classrooms. The prospective elementary teacher will experience initial teaching responsibilities at the novice level in culturally diverse public school settings. Field related topics are explored during seminar portion of course. A maximum of 50 hours of field experience required.
courses.prerequisites: Admitted to Multiple Subject Credential, EDU 5010 , EDU 5020 , EDU 5100 , and EDU 5302 .
courses.repeat_for_credit: May be taken multiple times Minimum - Maximum Units: Total credit limited to 6 units, with a maximum of 3 units per semester.

courses.title: Multiple Subject Clinical Practice
courses.description: Supervised teaching in university approved classroom. The prospective teacher will experience initial teaching responsibilities in culturally diverse public school settings. Multiple subject candidates connect theory to practice as they plan, teach and assess, reflect, and apply what they learn to promote learning environments based on equity, professional responsibilities, and Teacher Performance Expectations. Corequisite(s): EDU 5125 and EDU 5180 .
courses.prerequisites: Admitted to Multiple Subject Credential, admitted to Multiple Subject Clinical Practice, EDU 5105 or TED 444, EDU 5115 or TED 431, EDU 5120 or TED 451, EDU 5110 or TED 425, and EDU 5150 .

courses.title: Teaching Performance Assessment for Elementary Teachers
courses.description: Multiple subject candidates connect theory to practice as they plan, teach, and assess, and apply what they learn to promote learning environments based on equity, professional responsibilities, and Teacher Performance Expectations. Candidates successfully complete the California Teaching Performance Assessment Cycle 1 and the Literacy Performance Assessment. Corequisite(s): EDU 5125 and EDU 5160 .
courses.prerequisites: Admitted to Multiple Subject Credential, admitted to Multiple Subject Clinical Practice, EDU 5105 , EDU 5115 , EDU 5120 , EDU 5110 and EDU 5150 .
courses.repeat_for_credit: May be taken multiple times Minimum - Maximum Units: Total credit limited to 6 units, with a maximum of 3 units per semester.

courses.title: Educating Students with Disabilities in Diverse Settings
courses.description: Students will learn characteristics of K-12 students with disabilities, students who are at risk, and students who are gifted with a focus on access, equity, and effective assessment and instruction. Includes federal and state IEP and legislative requirements. Includes field experience across a variety of special education settings.
courses.prerequisites: Junior standing, ECS ITEP subplan/option, LS ITEP subplan/option, admitted to Multiple Subject Credential, admitted to Education Specialist Credential, or admitted to Single Subject Credential.
